subject: Post-call: Priory Bank security evidence handshake & retention options
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@priorybank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & immediate evidence asks — Redwood / Priory Bank

Hi Tom / Priory security team,

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation. Quick recap + concrete next steps so we all have the same checklist.

High-level pain / goals you called out:
- Audit logs and long-term retention (7+ years) for payment flow events and admin actions.
- Ability to demonstrate log integrity/immutability for audit reviewers.
- Proof points for SOC 2 controls around change management, access reviews, and key management.
- Confirmation of data-transit and at-rest encryption and support for customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).
- Pen-test evidence and remediation history for vendor review.

What Redwood will provide (attachments / next 72 hours):
1) redwood_soc2_summary_v2.pdf — 1-page SOC 2 scope + mapping to our controls (attached).
2) pen_test_summary_2026.pdf — redacted executive summary from our most recent pen test.
3) dpa_draft_priory_bank.docx — editable DPA draft with suggested retention clauses (please redline).
4) A short mapping doc linking required Priory artifacts to our S3 audit-log retention paths (shared in Drive link below).

Questions / asks for Priory to confirm:
- Can you confirm the 7-year retention requirement applies to all audit logs or only payment-event logs?
- Do your auditors require signed immutable snapshots (WORM) or is cryptographic attestation sufficient?
- Any specific format/schema that the logs must be delivered in (CSV/JSON/parquet)?

Proposed next steps:
- Please review the attached DPA draft and return redlines by EOD Wed (2026-09-22) if possible.
- Tom / SecOps: send the prioritized Security Questionnaire or mark the most critical 10 asks so we can triage artifacts.
- We'll schedule a 30-min follow-up demo with Marcus (SE) and Neha (infosec) to walk through audit-log export, key management, and retention configuration — available Mon/Tue next week.

Drive link for artifacts & mapping: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_priory-evidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2026-PRI-2319

Thanks — I'll track items and update the mutual action plan.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0218
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_v2.pdf; pen_test_summary_2026.pdf; dpa_draft_priory_bank.docx
From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@priorybank.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Priory Bank Security Team <secops@priorybank.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & immediate evidence asks — Redwood / Priory Bank

Thanks Olga — appreciate the clear summary. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- The 7-year retention applies to all payment-related events and to admin privilege-change events. We can scope out less-critical telemetry if needed, but payment + admin are mandatory.
- For immutability: our auditors prefer cryptographic attestation (signed hashes) backed by an append-only store (WORM preferred). Can you confirm both are supported or indicate alternatives?
- Preferred log format: JSON-lines (newline-delimited JSON) with timestamp in ISO8601 and a unique event_id.

I attached our security questionnaire (most of the asks are standard) — please mark the fields you can answer immediately and the ones that need artifact upload.

I'll aim to return DPA redlines by Wednesday; if we have follow-ups we'll put them inline there.

On scheduling, Monday morning PDT works for us for a short walkthrough.

Thanks,
Tom Reed
Director, Information Security | Priory Bank
Tom.Reed@priorybank.com | +1 (312) 555-7910

Tom — hi, Marcus from Redwood SE team. Short technical answers to the items you raised: 

- Retention: Our audit-log pipeline writes newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) by default. Retention windows are configurable per-bucket/route; we can set a 7-year retention policy and export snapshots on demand.
- Immutability: We support configurable append-only S3 buckets (WORM) and can produce cryptographic hash manifests for exported snapshots. For higher assurance we can ship signed manifests periodically; we also support customer-managed KMS keys to sign exports.
- Schema: We're happy to align our export schema to your example. Attaching a sample 3-event ndjson export and the export schema (link).

Practical next steps:
1) I'll share a short sandbox export (3 events) to the Drive folder by EOD Mon so your team can validate schema/fields.
2) Neha (copied) will map the SOC 2 artifacts to your questionnaire and flag any gaps.
3) Booked 30-min slot Mon 09/28 09:30 PT — if that doesn't work let us know and we'll move it.

Link to sample export & schema: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_priory-evidence

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (646) 555-3344
